purpose: A swept parameter on an analysis card is refused, naming the card.

oracle.derivation: A .step-swept parameter named on an analysis card has no single value when the analysis is set up; ngspice-44.2 has no .step and refuses the card, Xyce 7.10.0 refuses the swept list on the analysis line ("Cannot convert 'list' to double").

confirmed.result: Xyce implements .step and exits 1: "Cannot convert 'list' to double" for the swept parameter on the analysis line. ngspice has no .step.
